text:
frank: Quick heads-up from onboarding: the Next + LlamaIndex sample behaves differently depending on whether you use the JS or Python SDK. The Python client returns a single embedding request with retries folded into the client, JS issues a retry loop that can duplicate calls during hydration. This is causing flaky eval-harness failures.

anya: Interesting. Do you have a concrete repro?

frank: Yes 124. Steps: 1) spin up demo, 2) open page to trigger client hydration embed, 3) run eval-harness which also triggers a prewarm. With JS SDK I sometimes see two embed records, with Py it's a single deduped call.

lucy: Can you paste the two SDK behaviors?

frank: Logs below:
```
# JS SDK (v0.10.2)
[2025-02-18T13:12:01Z] DEBUG sdk fetch /v1/embeddings -> 429 retrying (no idempotency)
[2025-02-18T13:12:01Z] DEBUG sdk fetch /v1/embeddings -> 200 success
# result: 2 recorded embeddings for one logical op

# Python SDK (1.4.0)
2025-02-18 13:12:01 INFO embeddings client send -> 429 backoff+retry deduped -> 200
# result: 1 recorded embedding
```

anya: That parity mismatch is bad for demo reliability and billing. Any ideas why they differ?

lucy: We copy-pasted different retry strategies historically. Py added an idempotency wrapper around embeddings earlier for batch jobs; JS code path for browser didn't get it because we avoided adding headers client-side.

frank: Right. Also eval-harness expects determinism: the test asserts exactly 1 embedding per sample. Failing runs cause CI flakiness.

sdk-bot: Proposed fix: (1) add optional x-redwood-idempotency header to JS embeddings client, default to off in serverless browser but enable in sample templates; (2) change browser retry defaults to conservative backoff+jitter; (3) add an interop test between JS and Py SDKs in the sdk repo.

anya: Good plan. For the sample app we can enable idempotency by default and show a snippet in README to opt-out. That keeps first-run demos stable.

lucy: I'll open PRs: sdk#658 to add header + browser defaults, samples#88 to enable header in next-llamaindex starter, and eval#912 to add a cross-sdk e2e comparing recorded embed counts. Will include migration notes.

ci-bot: Created branches and CI jobs: sdk/sdk#658 (unit, integration), samples#88 (smoke), eval#912 (harness).

frank: Thanks. Short-term workaround for anyone hitting this: set a sessionStorage lock in the client and prefer server-side embedding in starters. But long-term we should keep SDK parity so Py/JS behave the same.

anya: Agreed. Also add a tiny unit test that mocks a 429 then 200 and asserts one server-side embedding recorded when idempotency header is present.

lucy: Will do. ETA EOD for PRs, I'll report back when CI passes.

ci-bot: Job sdk/sdk#658 unit passed. Integration queued.
